description: NexaMusic 0.1.4 Beta — Radio and Explore redesign, Pod selection polish, and discovery UI improvements.

changelog.title: What's new
items: Introduced Apple Music V3 lyrics as a beta style, with improved typography, spacing, word timing, and smoother lyric auto-scrolling.
Improved duet and multi-vocalist lyric alignment so each singer's lines retain their identity and positioning.
Added animated interlude indicators and refined timed-lyrics rendering.
Refreshed Search colours and Settings icons with a more consistent, colourful Apple Music-inspired appearance.
Restored YouTube Music playlist synchronization in the Library.
Fixed guest playback truncation on streams that do not report their total length.
Improved transition timing and playback handoff behaviour.
Optimized lyrics rendering, Liquid Glass effects, and tab animations to reduce unnecessary work.
Added a sign-in reminder for logged-out users, with a preference to hide it.
Added automatic update checks, beta-release support, background APK downloads, and update notifications.
Moved the Pod BETA label out of the playback screen and into the Player Style selection, where users choose Pod.
Redesigned Radio station cards so artwork stays unobstructed, station names and first tracks sit below covers, and the on-air station has a dedicated hero card.
Made the red ON AIR hero appear only while a radio station is actively playing; it stays hidden when playback is paused, stopped, or playing unrelated content.
Redesigned Explore featured albums, release shelves, and mood tiles with clean cover-first layouts and a stable, non-repeating flat-colour palette.
Removed artwork-derived blur and tint from the Radio and Explore top chrome so titles and status-bar areas stay readable.
Added a smooth, scroll-linked header animation that transitions the large page title into a compact centred title as you scroll.
Updated the Radio and Explore headers to fade smoothly into the page background instead of showing a fixed colour band.
Refined the Search header background so its tint fades gently with scrolling and matches the active app theme.
Unified header title sizing and scroll animation styling for a more consistent look across screens.
Polished the shared tab header transition and its theme-matched fading background.
Added coordinated fade, lift and scale animations to large page titles, with a compact title appearing as the page scrolls.
Improved consistency of the header's title and profile-button transitions during scrolling.
Added a scroll-responsive frosted effect to Search that stays clear at the top and gradually appears as content moves underneath.
Updated the History header to transition smoothly with its scrolling content.
Made the header's frosted background respond to the active screen's scroll position and remain clear when the page is at the top.
Added the shared scroll-linked header animation to Home, Radio, Explore and Library.
Preserved Home's existing scrolling behaviour while synchronizing its header animation.
Applied the same smooth header transition to the local Home feed.
Added the shared scrolling header animation to Settings and its pages.
Added the shared scrolling header animation to Changelog, Party and Update.
Added a fading frosted top area to Album, Artist and Playlist detail screens while keeping their artwork layouts intact.
Introduced one consistent frosted header treatment with a progressive blur and theme-matched fade that follows the page scroll.
Kept the header animation in sync when returning to screens or restoring their previous scroll position.
Kept the YouTube Music / Your Library switch pinned beneath the compact Search title while browsing results.
Removed fixed colour bands from Album, Artist, Playlist, Update and Now Playing headers while preserving artwork and existing controls.
Improved header performance and accessibility with lighter visual fallbacks for battery-saving, reduced-transparency and reduced-motion settings.
Matched transparent status and navigation bars to the app's active light or dark Appearance setting.
Recorded the existing Haze 1.3.1 Apache-2.0 attribution in NOTICE; no additional blur library or dependency was introduced.
Refined the shared header's appearance and motion behaviour across its supported display settings.
Synced Home, Radio, Explore and Library header animations with their actual restored list positions.
Added compact centred titles to Album, Artist, Playlist and Now Playing as their artwork scrolls away, without changing the artwork.
Updated Changelog and Update with the shared frosted header and removed the fixed colour strip above the Update screen.
Made the Listen Together / Party header follow its own scroll position.
Kept short pages in their clear, expanded-header state when there is not enough content to scroll.
Extended the same large-to-compact title transition to other scrolling screens that use the shared screen layout.

changelog.title: Notes
items: Apple Music V3 lyrics are still in beta; timing and alignment can vary by track and lyrics provider.
Playlist synchronization requires a signed-in YouTube Music account.
Playback transitions and performance should be verified across different devices and tracks.
Dark/light appearance and device-specific scrolling performance still require physical-device verification.
Automated token tests cover the shared motion math; full UI, accessibility, fallback, refresh-rate, and physical-device tests are not yet verified.
Smooth Blur Header code now uses one shared scroll-progress contract, a six-layer masked Haze stack, theme-derived tint, and a pinnable Search source row.

Fallback policy: API below 31, battery saver, low-RAM or low-performance devices use the 85% theme scrim; Reduce transparency uses 92%; Reduce motion crossfades titles over 150ms; repeated slow frames switch to scrim for the rest of the session.
Haze 1.3.1 is already present in the project and is Apache-2.0 licensed; its attribution is recorded in NOTICE.

Smooth Header token unit tests cover the six blur layers, fade masks, 90dp collapse distance, tint and fallback values. Build verification is pending for the latest branch commit; physical-device 60/120fps measurements have not been run.
